name: agent-router
description: Choose subagent models with /agent-models and inspect activity, routing, and per-agent prompt cache bars with /agent-cache. Requires Claude Code Mod function hooks enabled.

cache_ttl.title: Cache lifetime estimate
cache_ttl.description: Display estimate only; does not change provider cache control. Response-reported 5m/1h write buckets take precedence for every provider. When absent, auto follows Claude's TTL settings for an explicit Anthropic API endpoint and leaves third-party TTL unknown. Choose 5m or 1h only when your provider uses that lifetime.

scout_model.title: Scout model
scout_model.description: Choose the scout's model with /agent-models, or enter an exact model ID.

scout_effort.title: Scout effort
scout_effort.description: Reasoning effort for the scout role. Default keeps the engine's effort; models without effort support ignore it.
